messages:
lena (People Ops): FYI: performance calibration guidance updated in handbook and we're adding a 15-min mandatory "unconscious bias" microtraining for all managers. Goal: reduce rating variance. Launch timeline: announce Mon, training live Tue, manager attest by end of month. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/perf-calib-tracker
ben (People Ops): Will the training be manager-only or org-wide? Also need manager attestation form fields.
rachel (Talent Partner): Manager-only for this cycle. Gen population training later. Attestation form fields: manager_email, org_team, attestation_date, total_reports, calibrated_reports_count, notes.
omar (Legal): Handled  added sample language for calibration notes retention and privacy considerations. Also flagged that calibration notes older than 2 years should be archived unless legal hold.
handbook-bot: Handbook v3.5 published: /policies/performance-calibration  updates: Calibration process, Data retention, Training requirement.
kevin (Eng Manager): Can we get per-team CSV of who completed training and who still outstanding? Weekly digest would help.
lena (People Ops): Yes  nightly CSV to gs://redwood-hr-exports/perf-calib/ and weekly digest on Mondays. Managers must attest by 2026-06-30. Acting managers may attest if documented.
ben (People Ops): Recruiting/onboarding note: add to manager checklist: "Complete calibration training before running review cycles." Also add to new manager onboarding.
rachel (Talent Partner): We'll pilot with 5 managers this Fri. Also running a 30-min drop-in for Qs next Wed 11am PT (Omar will join).
omar (Legal): Qs ok. Also added a short FAQ in handbook about what to document in calibration notes.
lena (People Ops): Final actions: Ben to set up CSV export and digest, Rachel to run pilot and update onboarding, Omar to add legal notes to tracker, handbook-bot already published link. I'll announce on Mon. Flag blockers here.
handbook-bot: Annotation by lena (People Ops): added examples, retention schedule, and training link.
